title: Zesty Crumbly Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice
description: A cultured and crumbly Jamaican dish featuring gochujang and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients, this crowd pleaser is a must try. It combines the flavors of Jamaica with the spiciness of gochujang.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gochujang and soy sauce to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir fry for 1 minute.
Add the chopped scallions to the skillet and stir fry for 1 minute.
Serve the Zesty Crumbly Jamaican Chicken Fried Rice hot.
